initialLocation: client-memory-only; legacy request bodies and durable formats unchanged

context.sessionOwnerId: captured current user ID; not business owner authority
context.sourceRevision: opaque existing source/read stamp; never descriptor capability
context.suppFobRevision: existing extra CAS for price-related units
context.noteColumnDefsRevision: required when custom note values are involved

target.rowReference: module+source/view generation+ordinal for display binding only
target.duplicatePolicy: existing business-key peer fanout; no invented unique owner/source row

slotEncoding.rule: never null-pad missing keys or compare them only with JSON.stringify; unsupported values/accessors/prototypes return unsupported before effects

forwardExample.serverMetadata: saved author/time comes from server response/saved source, never client ownership claims

inverseExample.expected: the acknowledged normalized after slots and applicable current revision/context
inverseExample.restore: the captured before slots/presence and original override intent
inverseExample.serverRestriction: ordinary legacy note writes restamp authors and may create a tombstone; exact native absence/authorship undo needs a trusted receipt adapter, so unsupported network inverses stay on existing history path

applicationRules: Validate the complete unit/batch, owner context and all before slots before effects; no partial helper application.
Preparation clones only touched row/map records and mutable changed values; borrow untouched values read-only.
Authoritative raw snapshots and common compute replicas remain immutable to client helpers.
ACK applies a unit only when every current slot matches captured-before, including presence and type; later local edits remain pending.
Destination rows retain their object identity; update peer indexes/derived input revisions through existing root-owned hooks.
Forward coalescing keeps earliest before and latest after; inverse reverses unit order and swaps slots only after semantic adapter eligibility.
Undo on changed owner/source/revision/field value does not overwrite current data or advance stacks as if successful.
Unrecognized field families use the old complete path for the entire batch; do not partially apply supported rows and discard the rest.

semanticUnits.name: notes-primary/extra
semanticUnits.ownerGate: existing edit scope; preserve note writer policy

semanticUnits.name: custom-note
semanticUnits.inverseGate: definition still exists and revision matches

semanticUnits.name: delivery-type
semanticUnits.inverseGate: absent delivery override is not expressible as delType:null; retain old path unless exact native adapter exists

semanticUnits.name: date-revision
semanticUnits.ownerGate: existing shared owner plus edit scope
semanticUnits.inverseGate: existing date/null removal and receipt semantics

semanticUnits.name: supplier-price
semanticUnits.ownerGate: existing shared owner plus edit scope
semanticUnits.inverseGate: existing pricingRestore and current-rule recalculation; not display scalar rollback

futureAdditiveReceiptBoundary.optionalResponseOnly: versioned appliedChanges/receiptRef only for opted-in supported units; legacy response fields remain
requiredGuards: fresh owner check at actual commit
futureAdditiveReceiptBoundary.prohibited: accepting arbitrary browser-supplied native receipt maps or claiming a detached CP mirror is already WAL durable
futureAdditiveReceiptBoundary.state: separate bounded follow-up, blocked until persistence/absence semantics are closed
